component.name: ACMX Interface
component.summary: OpenGL and Vulkan real-time video shader interface

description.p: ACMX is a real-time video processing environment with a shared Qt interface for the ACMX2 OpenGL and ACMXVK Vulkan backends. This package includes both non-CUDA engines, fragment and compute shader workflows, live audio and MIDI support, the ACMXVK shader-library builder, and the MIDI-map companion utility.

ul.li: Fix ACMXVK live shader reload when Flatpak canonicalizes home paths from /home to /var/home.
Add the ACMXVK 0.33.1 Vulkan backend alongside ACMX2.
Add fragment and compute shader library building and live reload support.
Update the Qt interface and MIDI-map utility to their current versions.
Keep live shader reload indices aligned for shader filenames containing "material".
Synchronize Qt-to-engine shared-memory updates with a named POSIX semaphore.
Run shader-library exports in the background to keep the interface responsive.
Improve full 360-degree rotation handling.
Fix shader selection mapping for libraries, multi-pass effects, and playlists.
Add File menu actions for loading shader libraries and recently used libraries.
Add a shader library builder for creating portable fragment and compute shader collections.
Fix Default-resolution window sizing for low-resolution video input under Flatpak.
Add OpenGL compute shaders, including mixed fragment and compute multipass chains and binary caching.
Add compute-shader authoring and shader-type display to the Qt interface.
Add a searchable built-in shader uniform reference and faster multipass replacement.
Filter duplicate secondary V4L2 camera nodes on Linux.
Retain the Intel IPP-optimized OpenCV 4.12.0 build and runtime SIMD dispatch.
Make shader-editor current-line and GLSL syntax colors adapt to light and dark interface themes.
Build OpenCV with Intel IPP 2022.1.0 and runtime SIMD dispatch for optimized x86_64 CPU processing.
Add a direct documentation link to the Flatpak release page.
Add sequential M3U/M3U8 audio playback with full-playlist repeat.
Add a Qt M3U playlist editor with ordering, sorting, shuffling, open, and save actions.
Show the current audible track filename in the playback HUD.
